next_action: Register the priority projects in the project stage using the plan's 22 strategy programmes as the registration unit; register the governor's promises in the promise stage from the 2024 election bulletin after re-checking its availability, because the bulletin is not currently linked from the election commission's current governor-election page; add the assembly layer in the assembly stage; keep supplementary budgets, execution and settlement as separate states.
quality_boundary: The prefecture's top plan is the 4th Hare-no-kuni Okayama Iki-iki Plan (第4次晴れの国おかやま生き活きプラン), adopted in March 2025. It combines a long-term vision looking toward the mid-2040s with a four-year action plan for FY2025-FY2028, under the basic goal of realising an Okayama where every resident lives with a bright smile. Its action plan is organised into four priority strategies, 22 strategy programmes, 89 priority measures and 68 promotion measures, measured by 99 Iki-iki indicators. Okayama Prefecture had no reviewed package in this repository before this stage, so this review rests on the prefecture's and the MIC's own published documents alone. Project units, their amounts and their evaluation states are registered in a later project stage; the FY2026 initial budget and the FY2022-FY2024 ordinary-account settlements are registered as separate fiscal records.
